    ])

    n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.1, max_depth=3, random_state=42
)

pipe = Pipeline(steps=[
    ('preprocessor', preprocessor),
    ('model', model)
])

pipe.fit(X, y)

# Bounds based on max/min of training data
bounds_dict = {
    'C': (0.0011, 1.2),
    'Mn': (0.0021, 2.0),
    'Si': (0.0002, 1.5),
